title: Suno debuts Speech, which generates spoken voices from scripts or prompts, with optional background music, in public beta, as its music generator faces lawsuits (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: Suno debuts Speech, which generates spoken voices from scripts or prompts, with optional background music, in public beta, as its music generator faces lawsuits — The new Speech feature provides synthetic voiceovers embellished with AI background music.
